label: Я бы
description: A 10-sentence card for the standalone result frame … бы + past meaning would do.

missions.phrase: Я бы с радостью поехал с вами.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Standalone would-statement. The result clause бы plus past поехал means would go, with no spoken if-clause. The particle бы always combines with a past-tense verb form, so поехал reads as hypothetical, not past.
Strategic focus: Soft advice with would. бы plus the past отдохнул gives a gentle you would do better to rest. бы is a mood particle here, not a tense marker, and it sits before the verb after ты.

missions.phrase: Он бы никогда так не поступил.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Hypothetical denial. бы plus past поступил denies an imagined action, he would never act that way. The particle is mobile and here follows the subject он.
Strategic focus: Polite would like. бы plus past хотели softens the request into we would like. The hypothetical framing makes it courteous rather than blunt.
Strategic focus: Would-have outcome. бы plus past закончили describes an unreal completion, they would have finished long ago. The same past form covers what English splits into would and would have.

missions.phrase: Я бы на твоём месте промолчала.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Would in your place. The phrase на твоём месте supplies the implied condition, and бы plus past промолчала gives the would-result. бы directly precedes the verb after я.
Strategic focus: Suggestion as would. бы plus past спросил works as a mild you should ask. бы always pairs with this past form, even though the advice points to the future.
Strategic focus: Willing would-statement. бы plus past помогла means she would gladly help. The hypothetical mood, carried by бы, leaves the help imagined rather than done.

missions.phrase: Мы бы остались ещё на день.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Conditional intention. бы plus past остались expresses we would stay another day, an outcome that depends on unspoken circumstances. бы follows the subject мы.
Strategic focus: Polite wish as would. бы plus past выпил frames a soft I would have a cup of coffee. The past form is required by бы and signals desire, not past action.
